newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices ease on speculative selling.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices ease on speculative selling.

text.p: Indian castor prices fell after rising initially on Wednesday, dealers said.
Export demand was absent, while continued pressure of arrivals from old crop kept the market quiet, one dealer said.
Groundnut oil fell 410/412 rupees to 404/405 per 10 kg on the back of rising new crop arrivals, while seasonal buyers kept away, expecting a further price fall, he said.
Rajkot, spot oil was steady at 550 rupees per 15 kg.
